description: The bar chart illustrates the comparison of factual errors across four different question-answering systems: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, Musique, and IIRC. The vertical axis represents the number of factual errors, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40. Each system is represented by a group of three bars, each bar corresponding to a different quality assurance (QA) method: NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA. The bars are color-coded, with NoR QA in yellow, OneR QA in red, and IRCoT QA in blue.
